verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical. Both have the same flaws: the header row (logo, tagline, address) is shrunk to roughly 9px and is barely readable; the middle headline line 'a daring adventure or' nearly touches both side edges; and there is a lot of empty sky above the header. These make both look like a shrunk-and-cropped copy rather than a real tall-format rearrangement. The only difference is the 'Helen Keller' attribution: in A it sits a little too far below the quote and starts to drift away from it, while B keeps it closer to the quote, as in the original.
